reference.question: Simplify \((-2x^2)^3\). What is the coefficient of the \(x^6\) term in the result?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Cube the numerical and variable factors

\((-2x^2)^3=(-2)^3\cdot(x^2)^3=-8x^6\).
